1306-5315-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-5315-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Mana Crypt, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

643-3510-4288-6705.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-3510-4288-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

751-6723-8201.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4279-5687-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2577-5670-6794.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

628-3899-7194.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

3240-3899-5632-6462.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2557-4365-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2034-5003-7921.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Autumn Willow, adding {C}{C}.
When Autumn Willow dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Autumn Willow from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Autumn Willow enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

5220-6505-6900-7492.description:
Cast Spore Frog by paying its mana cost.
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3480-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-3480-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
5256-6972-7607.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1824-2530-6709-7349.easyPrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1824-2530-6709-7349.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Diamond Mare triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2292-3317-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2292-3317-5972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-3504--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mercurial Pretender that has haste. Choose to have Mercurial Pretender enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Mercurial Pretender token instead.
618-3504--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Mercurial Pretender's toughness.

1479-1659-2841-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-1659-2841-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5078-6918-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
5078-6918-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

394-2034-5220-6753-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-2034-5220-6753-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

338-5641-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-5641-6720.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2510-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2510-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

643-703-4394-5231.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

1563-2457-2557-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1874-2034-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1874-2034-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

575-5073-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5073-5971.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Tinder Wall dies, Yedora triggers, returning Tinder Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Tinder Wall enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tinder Wall by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Tinder Wall face-up.
Repeat.

2034-2781-4875-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2034-2781-4875-6243.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

549-1251-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-1251-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-1251-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-3484-5391-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You have at least three energy counters.
851-3484-5391-5902.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

372-2187-2955.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Possessed Skaab exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
372-2187-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

372-3277-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3277-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2136-2178-4050-5221.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
2136-2178-4050-5221.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sprouting Thrinax with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Sprouting Thrinax token, adding {R}.
When the Sprouting Thrinax token dies, it and Orthion trigger.
Resolve the Orthion trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Saprolings, you may forego sacrificing the Sprouting Thrinax tokens.
You may also then use Orthion's second ability targeting any creature you control.

2564-4231-4598-4823.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

962-2645-3430.notablePrerequisites: Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
962-2645-3430.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Once each player has infinite mana, use any of Staff of Domination's abilities, along with its first ability, to empty your mana pool.
Move to the next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the mana they lost.

500-1309-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-1309-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Salvager of Secrets and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Both Salvager of Secrets tokens enter the battlefield, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

889-3718.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
889-3718.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting any indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy the indestructible permanent and choosing to copy Chain of Acid, targeting the indestructible permanent with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

2316-2557-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-2557-5231.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

618-908-3572.notablePrerequisites: Disciple of Kangee does not have summoning sickness.
618-908-3572.description:
Pay {U} and tap Disciple of Kangee to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1309-1987-2427-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
